subject: Money
title: Zimbabwe's Collapse
description: A quick win: understand Zimbabwe's Collapse.

hook.text: Zimbabwe printed a 100-trillion-dollar bill. It couldn't buy a bus ticket.

buildup.text: Land reforms in 2000 collapsed agricultural output. The government printed money to cover the shortfall.

discovery.text: Inflation hit 79.6 billion percent per month in 2008. Prices doubled every 24 hours.

twist.text: Zimbabwe abandoned its currency entirely. People switched to U.S. dollars and South African rand.

climax.text: When a currency dies, daily life becomes barter. Trust in money is the foundation of modern civilization.

punchline.text: A trillion dollars. Worth less than the paper.

quiz.question: What did Zimbabwe do when its currency became worthless?
options: Abandoned its currency for foreign ones
